### Welcome to my corner of data storytelling.

Hi! I'm Min Khant Aung, a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University with a background in Computer Science.

I believe data becomes most valuable when we can turn numbers and complex research into stories that people can understand.

This website is where I explore interesting questions, share insights from research, and practise communicating data clearly and creatively.

:::
